text:
My top pick is the Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 140W + Qi2 if you want to charge your laptop, phone, and other accessories from one desktop unit. If your watch needs to charge wirelessly too, though, there’s an important distinction: the Baseus has a Qi2 phone pad, not a dedicated Apple Watch charger.

Based only on the search results you provided, here are the best options.

Best desk charging stations
Best for laptop + phone
1. Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 Desktop Charger 140W + Qi2
$149.99

One 140W USB-C port, a retractable 100W USB-C cable, additional USB ports, and a 15W Qi2 phone charging pad. Best for reducing desk clutter while powering a laptop and several accessories.

Watch charging: No dedicated watch charger.

 Buy at Baseus via Dealectric

Stock was reported sold out on Baseus's US store at the October 21, 2026 verification; check current availability.

Source: Dealectric product details

Best for phone + watch
2. Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station
$89.99 · often around $67–70 on sale

Charges an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously. Its compact, foldable design makes it ideal for a tidy desk.

Watch charging: Yes, for Apple Watch.
Laptop charging: You will need a separate laptop charger.

 Shop on Amazon

Source: StandDeskLab's 2026 guide

3. Belkin BoostCharge Pro 3-in-1 Charging Stand
$109.99–$120 list · frequently $56–80 on sale

Best if you prefer your phone upright and visible while it charges. It supports simultaneous charging of an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods.

Watch charging: Yes, for Apple Watch.
Laptop charging: Separate charger required.

 Shop on Amazon

Source: WIRED's 2026 wireless charger guide

4. Anker 341 USB-C Hub
Around $40

A budget-friendly wired option for a laptop-centric setup. It supports up to 100W power delivery passthrough, alongside connectivity for peripherals.

Watch charging: No dedicated watch charger.
Laptop charging: Yes, with a compatible USB-C power adapter.

My recommendation: If you want all three — laptop, phone, and watch — with the least desk clutter, consider pairing the Baseus Nomos with your watch's existing charging puck. If you have an Apple Watch, that combination covers your needs while retaining high-power laptop charging.

One question that would help me narrow it down: Which watch do you have — Apple Watch or Samsung/Galaxy Watch? That determines which charging stations can charge all three devices without extra accessories.
